boulders.approach: Surprisingly well hidden from the wash. Go up past the Bikini Bottom boulder and turn right to find the main routes on the Base Boulder

boulders.name: Beach Boulders
boulders.approach: Northwest of the Base Boulder, access to Sea Caves may be tricky due to the foliage

boulders.name: Bikini Bottom Boulder
boulders.approach: At the front of the south seas area, go left up ~20 feet from the wash, faces East-Northeast

boulders.name: Lighthouse Boulder
boulders.approach: Due Southeast of the Base Boulder

boulders.name: Pirate Boulder
boulders.approach: The farthest uphill from the wash, 5-6 minute hike from the first cairn. Go up as toward the storm boulder and turn left/Southeast along some flatter ridges to find the pirate boulder.

boulders.name: Space Boulder
boulders.approach: From the base boulder, walk directly uphill for 30 seconds to be at the space boulder. 2-3 minutes from the wash cairns

boulders.name: Storm Boulder
boulders.approach: A 3-4 minute hike from the wash, up behind and climber's left from the space boulder.

boulders.name: Voyage Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow cairns behind the Space and Beach boulders to the cliff base and trend up and southeast until you are above the Storm boulder. Go up the wide, slabby, smooth chimney and trend back west (climber's right) up a few…

boulders.name: Stagehand Boulders
boulders.approach: The Stagehand Boulders are about 40’ left of the trail as it turns around the corner into the wash from Monkey Bars. The problems are located on the boulder facing away from the trail.

boulders.name: Super Nova Boulder
boulders.approach: Located just upcanyon of Mr Moran on the left (south) side of the wash.

boulders.name: Abstraction Corridor
boulders.approach: In a small corridor behind Americana Exotica . Easiest to access by scrambling up left of that boulder.

boulders.name: Americana Exotica
boulders.approach: Scramble up and around several boulders before reaching the platform that is the flat landing for this problem.

boulders.name: The Con Artist
boulders.approach: Go to Book of Nightmares and turn around.

boulders.name: Giant Boulder
boulders.approach: Pile of boulders on the right side of the canyon as you are walking back.

boulders.name: Stake Your Claim
boulders.approach: The obvious face in the middle of the cluster.

boulders.name: Tailpipe Boulder
boulders.approach: The quickest way is by hiking northwest from the Kraft parking lot, towards the West Cluster, and then continuing up the very steep hill past Yin and Yang, before trending downhill and northeast towards the Gateway…

boulders.name: House Troupe Boulder
boulders.approach: One of the first boulders reach after leaving the wash.

boulders.name: Tornado Corridor
boulders.approach: From Mr. Moran hike uphill to the north for about 100 yards. The area will be in the second large depression to your left beside the swirly cliff.

boulders.name: Triple Sow Cow Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach as per Mr Moran and then head underneath and to the right of Mr Moran and the boulder will be in front of you

boulders.name: Valley of Elah
boulders.approach: Follow trail till it splits into the wash. Stay left instead and climb the class 3 approach. A

boulders.name: Vantablack Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Kraft parking lot turn left to hike Northwest past the West Cluster and around the left side of Kraft Mountain. After you get over the apex of the hill, you will take a right fork that trends towards a small…

boulders.name: Wheel Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike to the Monkey Bar Boulder. From there continue along the trail and then turn right to cross the wash after 100 yards. Turn right and walk along the base of the cliff band, past a small outcrop sport crag with bolts…

boulders.name: Curse / Dreams Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Honeycomb Boulder , head left and uphill in the first steep gully to the right as if you were to be going to the top of some of the sport crags. Follow that uphill for around 5 minutes, where you'll reach a…

boulders.name: Candy Cane Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach as for Chuck Wall . The boulder is on your left before the last stretching heading up to that cliff.

boulders.name: Dog Wall Bouldering
boulders.approach: See "Getting There" for Dog Wall .

boulders.name: Hydropower Boulder
boulders.approach: Approached by heading southeast, downhill into the wash from the First Pullout. 10 minutes hike. You’ll find the boulder on the left side of the trail.

boulders.name: Influencer Boulder
boulders.approach: Right in between Margin of Error boulder and Tiger Lilly boulder on left side trail

boulders.name: Kissing Butterflies Boulder
boulders.approach: 15-20 minutes from the First Pullout lot and 25-30 minutes from the Red Spring lot.

boulders.name: Sub Zero Boulder
boulders.approach: Faces Hydropower, just up the hill.

boulders.name: Team B Boulder
boulders.approach: Visible from and along the path of the wash. 15-20 minutes from the First Pullout lot and about 25 minutes from the Red Spring lot.

boulders.name: Tiger Lily Boulder
boulders.approach: The Tiger Lily boulder rests in the wash, midway between First Pullout parking and Moderate Mecca. Refer to Tom Moulin's Southern Nevada Bouldering II for exact approach details.

boulders.name: Margin of Error Boulder
boulders.approach: One of two large boulders you first encounter down in the wash.

boulders.name: Playground Love Boulder
boulders.approach: Approached by heading southeast, downhill into the wash from the First Pullout

boulders.name: Sandy Cheeks Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow the approach to the Hamlet until you get to the red sandy path that bends around the boulder on the right.

boulders.name: Bouldering is Training
boulders.approach: Go to the far right side of The Gallery and step downhill a little. he route is the obvious chalked line up the bulge.

boulders.name: Lower Balcony
boulders.approach: Upon reaching the "ladder" feature that leads to the upper tier section of Box Seat, bear right to reach another large wall just below Upper Balcony.

boulders.name: Upper Balcony
boulders.approach: If approaching from the spine, climb the short "ladder" to get to the upper tier section of Box Seat.

boulders.name: Bus Wedge Boulder
boulders.approach: At the bottom of the Magic Bus crag, just to the right of the main routes.

boulders.name: The Busasaurus
boulders.approach: At the Magic Bus crag, just left of the main wall.

boulders.name: Laffy Taffy
boulders.approach: From the bottom of the second pullout trail head right down the wash and head toward the black corridor area

boulders.name: Raether Problem
boulders.approach: From the bottom of the second pullout trail in the wash head right down the wash. Head near the Meister's Edge then cut left to the Black Corridor, then when near the Black Corridor head right on the trial past Laffy…

boulders.name: Tiny Dancer Boulder
boulders.approach: Above Laffy Taffy .

boulders.name: Hang Loose
boulders.approach: The boulder is located 20 feet northeast of Jonny Jamcrack at the Meister's Edge crag along the wash. The boulder is on the right when approaching from the first or second pullout.

boulders.name: Stay for Orange Skies Boulders
boulders.approach: Hike up the trail to Meetup Wall. Upon reaching the top of the hill and end of the trail where you'd normally turn right and arrive at Meetup Wall, turn left instead. Walk across the top of the ridge to an obvious…

boulders.name: Laidback Corridor
boulders.approach: The corridor is a little hard to spot from the trail. The easiest way to get there is to walk to find Skylight and go left (north) at the base before dropping down a short slab to the corridor

boulders.name: Skylight Boulder
boulders.approach: The most obvious boulder in the cluster. Walk past The Beach along the Calico Tanks trail and then scramble up the short hillside to the boulder.

boulders.name: The Upper Beach
boulders.approach: Scramble directly up from The Beach Boulders or take a slightly less steep approach via the chute on the left of the The Beach which is also the typical approach for Greg's Arete Area .

boulders.name: Calico Tanks Summit Boulders
boulders.approach: Pin and approach is to Eternal Optimist. Other climbs can be accessed from this point. Starting at the Sandstone Quarry parking lot, follow the Calico Tanks Trail until where it exits for the James Brown Wall. Continue…

boulders.name: Java Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach as for Trophy Wall . This is the white, railed boulder directly across from a cool, red wave of rock a few minutes before reaching Trophy.

boulders.name: Monstro's Gaping Maw
boulders.approach: 20 minute approach time. Walk the Turtlehead Peak Trail to the Twinkie / Trophy turn-off area. Continue west up the main wash, past the Twinkie for 100 yards. Leave the wash at a trail sign, and follow the rising trail…

boulders.name: Party Pants Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk to the Twinkie via the Turtlehead Peak Trail. Continue west up the wash, past the Twinkie for 100 yards. Leave the wash at a trail sign, and follow the rising trail to the northwest (right), continuing as for…

boulders.name: The Pier Boulders
boulders.approach: Park at Sandstone Quarry and follow the trail for the pier. The giant wavestorm boulder will be visible to your left as you near the crag.

boulders.name: The Propane Tank Boulder
boulders.approach: Take the main trail from Sandstone Quarry North out of the parking lot for about 3 minutes, on the right you should see the large boulder in the Wash. This is it.

boulders.name: Trophy Crack
boulders.approach: Keep hiking East past Trophy Wall for about 100 feet and look for a large boulder. On the opposite side of this boulder is the expanding OW splitter.

boulders.name: Vaya Con Queso Boulders
boulders.approach: Approach as for The Twinkie , but continue beyond that cliff along the Turtlehead Peak trail. The trail will curve right to the edge of the sandstone. As soon as the sandstone ends, head right along a more faint trail.…

boulders.name: Wake-up Wall Boulders
boulders.approach: Approach as for the Wake-up Wall. Walk over the notch on the west end. Continue for roughly 100 yards to a group of large blocks.

boulders.name: Desert Bloom
boulders.approach: Head West from the dirt parking lot and follow the main trail maybe 10 minutes until you see the boulder on the other side of the ravine to the right. 36.1734560, -115.4815821

boulders.name: Pepino Boulder
boulders.approach: Boulder is visible from the parking lot, dead ahead slightly up the hillside. Maybe 10 min walk from the lot. Coordinates 36.1742176, -115.4818996

boulders.name: Rambo Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk West from the upper parking lot maybe 15 minutes. Will be on the hillside in a small gully. Hard to see from the approach, best to use the gps coordinates.

boulders.name: Real Hot Girl Shit
boulders.approach: Prob just use the gps coordinates.

boulders.name: Seinfeld Boulders
boulders.approach: On top of the ridge. Only about 10 minutes up from The Till.

boulders.name: AC/DC Boulder
boulders.approach: Beyond the Sugar Baby boulder & up the wash. There are some cairns to guide the way but it'll be up the wash on the way to Arrakis.

boulders.name: Acid Test
boulders.approach: From the bend in the main trail, find a social trail that follows a slight wash with some potential cairns. Once near the boulder, find a way through the vegetation. Currently no well defined trail.

boulders.name: Arrakis
boulders.approach: Keep following the creek up the canyon past the AC/DC boulder. May be better to go around to the right of the creek to avoid a lot of scrambling. Established climbs are on back of boulder as you are approaching.

boulders.name: Crack Baby
boulders.approach: From the White Rock/Willow Springs loop trail, sight the boulder from the trail and attempt to find a slightly open path through the vegetation. Currently not much of a social trail.

boulders.name: Just Say No
boulders.approach: Around White Rock Spring North and the Enclaves.

boulders.name: Space Oddity
boulders.approach: Follow directions to the Sugar Baby boulder using Tom Moulin's excellent guide book. From there, Space Oddity is the huge boulder, 50 ft. east of the Sugar Baby.

boulders.name: Sugar Baby Boulder
boulders.approach: Hike the Willow Springs/White Rock trail from lost creek parking lot. After .7 miles take a left and hike through openings in the trees along a faint (nonexistent) social trail heading North. Follow this trail and a few…

boulders.name: Ziggy Stardust
boulders.approach: Follow directions to the Sugar Baby using Tom Moulin's excellent bouldering guide. From there, the Ziggy Stardust boulder is about 100ft. to the northeast. The problems face more or less to the east. Use Space Oddity as…

boulders.name: Supple Leopard
boulders.approach: This boulder is located in the northern-most drainage of white rock springs. It is tricky to find, but the best way is to keep to the dry creek-bed, following it uphill.

boulders.name: Beach Boulder
boulders.approach: 5 minute walk from the main parking area (if you have a cat on a leash; probably 2 minutes if it's just a human crew). Head towards Brown Round, pass it, and then look for the jutting shelf on your left.

boulders.name: Big Brown Boulder (aka Brown Round)
boulders.approach: Large boulder west of the Indian Hands fenced off area.

boulders.name: Bonsai Boulder
boulders.approach: Bonsai climbs a roof found adjacent to the trail, about 150 yards east of Lucky Charms.

boulders.name: Down the Line Boulder
boulders.approach: Take trails from Peruvian Flake uphill towards north east. Boulder can be hard to find if you go off trail Alternatively, can be found by skirting below large boulders near Name Plate and then heading left (north west)…

boulders.name: Getaway Boulder
boulders.approach: Park at the second parking lot with a bathroom on the Willow Springs road. Hike to the right while exiting the parking lot and contour around the closed area (native american hieroglyphs) and up the hill. This is the…

boulders.name: Arete
boulders.approach: Directly across from Watermark. Walk all the way to the waterfall and make a 180. It's directly next to the trail you hike in on.

boulders.name: Princess Rainbow Sparkle Area
boulders.approach: Park at the Lost Creek parking lot and hike Southwest. Take your first left and head South on the SMYC trail. This will pass through a wash and then go up a small red ridge-line. After .4 miles from the car there will…

boulders.name: Sound of the Fall
boulders.approach: Just downstream from the waterfall. If you get to the waterfall, you can follow the streambed downwards and make a left just after you jump down a 4 foot boulder.

boulders.name: Watermark
boulders.approach: To get to this boulder, follow the Lost Creek trail to the bowl at the end. Turn to your right (north?) and Watermark is visible in the trees just off the trail.

boulders.name: Lost Creek Parking Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Lost Creek Parking, look up-canyon (NNW) and notice the nice varnished face. Follow the White Rock Loop Trail (begins on the opposite side of the road from where you parked) to the boulder.

boulders.name: Belgian Toothpaste
boulders.approach: While traveling upstream through Mystery Canyon, about halfway between Sad Robot and the Wobble boulder, take a left and scramble up an easy rock slab to venture far up the hill. While on the hill. Follow a couple…

boulders.name: Peter & The Wolf
boulders.approach: Park at Willow Springs parking and hike as for "Salt is Salty". Peter & The Wolf is just above "Salt Is Salty"

boulders.name: Ready Boulder
boulders.approach: 20 feet downstream of Peter and the Wolf, on the right in between some bushes.

boulders.name: Sad Robot
boulders.approach: This is the first boulder you'll approach as you're walking up canyon. It's in a right facing corner with a massive house sized boulder to the left.

boulders.name: Salt is Salty
boulders.approach: From Sad Robot, Hike up the wash about 20 minutes until you reach Quadruped. From Quadruped crawl through a small corridor that opens into the the jumble where Salt is Salty is located.

boulders.name: The Underminer
boulders.approach: About two minutes of walking past the sad robot boulder. Stay in the wash.

boulders.name: Wobble
boulders.approach: Follow directions to the Sad Robot boulder at the start of Mystery Canyon. Continue up the wash 300 yards to the Wobble boulder.

boulders.name: Name Plate Boulder
boulders.approach: From the picnic area, follow the trail east. At the Bonsai boulder (a roof just north of the trail), hang a left and hike uphill to another tall, prominent overhang. The Name Plate boulder is tucked behind this.

boulders.name: Peruvian Flake Boulder
boulders.approach: Park at the second parking lot with a bathroom on the Willow Springs road. Hike to the right while exiting the parking lot and contour around the closed area (native american hieroglyphs) and up the hill. This is the…

boulders.name: The Innkeeper Boulder
boulders.approach: Park normally for the Red Rock Wash boulders. Walk down the road until directly below the boulder. Then, trudge up the hill for about 15 minutes, aiming left (west) of the boulder. See approach image. The Innkeeper is…

boulders.name: Pirouette Boulder
boulders.approach: From "The Innkeeper", scramble 2 minutes up and left (northwest) to the base of the craggy cliffs and the obvious white block. The climbs are on the north side of the boulder.

boulders.name: Ride the White Horse
boulders.approach: About 400 yards up the wash from the gravel road. The boulder is right in the center of the wash.

boulders.name: The Rubric
boulders.approach: A large boulder with a huge roof a few hundred yards past Mothers Crag into the Red Rock Wash. About one hundred yards before (north of) the "Ride The White Horse" boulder, on the west side of the wash.

boulders.name: Stampede
boulders.approach: Obvious roof on the south side of the wash, about 15 minutes from the dirt road. Just upstream of Ride the White Horse.

boulders.name: Triangle Boulder
boulders.approach: South side of the wash, a few minutes from the road. Easy to see from the wash if you are looking.

boulders.name: Shit House Boulder
boulders.approach: Park at the Willow Springs picnic area. Located immediately NW of the Brown Round Boulder.

boulders.name: 100 More Feet
boulders.approach: Follow the wash into icebox canyon until you see the pool of water towards the base of the waterfall. It is on the left side.

boulders.name: Admiral Raccoon
boulders.approach: Keep walking along Dale's Trail past Buffalo Ball several minutes. Admiral Raccoon boulder will be visible ahead in the distance, with a tree obscuring the face you approach.

boulders.name: American Idiot
boulders.approach: follow the main trail it starts to split. You’ll be able to see the boulder cause it’s the highest boulder in the area.

boulders.name: CREAM Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow the main Ice Box Canyon trail until the Maze Gully boulders are visible to the south. Head down into the wash and follow the wash upstream about 100 yards until you reach the boulder.

boulders.name: Frigid Air Buttress Boulders
boulders.approach: Park in the Ice Box pullout and start to head down the trail as if you were going to go to the "waterfall" of Ice Box. After a 5 min hike or so you will start to see the wash on your left becoming deeper and deeper…

boulders.name: Icarus Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Icebox parking, follow the Icebox trail until the juncture with Dale's trail is reached. Follow Dale's trail south about 5 minutes past the Buffalo Ball boulder, then find your way west into the gully. I would…

boulders.name: Ice Box 1
boulders.approach: Approach using directions from Tom Moulin's bouldering guide.

boulders.name: Ice Box 2
boulders.approach: Follow the ice box trail until it nears the wash next to a few large boulders.

boulders.name: Ice Giants
boulders.approach: Park at and hike into Ice Box canyon on the main trail 20-30 minutes. These enormous boulders are visible from the parking lot and 100 ft off of the main trail.

boulders.name: The Landing Deck
boulders.approach: It's a fun scramble up the ice box trail. Once you come to the trickle falls go to the right upward to a set of fixed lines. Scale this no gimme wall to the landing deck. Best have respect for this place. Don't leave no…

boulders.name: Shoe Polish
boulders.approach: 10 minutes up the wash from the We Need Ice Boulder

boulders.name: Watchman Boulder
boulders.approach: From the Icebox parking, follow the Icebox trail until the juncture with Dale's trail is reached. Follow Dale's trail south about 5 minutes past the Buffalo Ball boulder. The boulder will be visible just west of the…

boulders.name: Water Buffalo Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow the main Ice Box Canyon trail until the Maze Gully boulders are visible to the south. Head down into the wash and follow the wash upstream about 50 yards, the boulder will be just out of the wash to the right…

boulders.name: We Need Ice
boulders.approach: Park at the Icebox Canyon pullout on Scenic Loop Drive. 20-30 minute approach to the boulders.

boulders.name: Baraka Boulder
boulders.approach: From the trail hike for about 1.1 miles (25 minutes) past the old house foundations until you reach a triangle in the trail path (see attached photos). Take the left path towards the wash, and then take a right into the…

boulders.name: Critical Path Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow directions for Shining path. After hiking up the slab that is east of shining path, continue past the boulder on your right. You will reach a left hand turn at a red boulder that leads to Big Delicious (V2).…

boulders.name: Jurassic Art Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow directions for Baraka. From Baraka, hike up the hill just left of the boulder, trend left on the bushy hillside until the wash opens up and the trees start to disappear, then drop back into the wash. The boulder…

boulders.name: Red Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow the Baraka instructions, the boulder should be just to the left.

boulders.name: Red Hot
boulders.approach: Hike as for shining path. Instead of turning right towards the approach slab, continue left for 100 yards. The boulder will be on your right guarded by some shallow bushes you can drop pads on.

boulders.name: Shining Path
boulders.approach: To avoid as much bushwhacking as possible with pads, I advise taking the wash path to Baraka first, then taking an immediate right after the boulder to go 50 yards uphill. (This is about the midway point for the whole…

boulders.name: Calcifer
boulders.approach: Just past The Shining Path boulder in the canyon to the left. You will walk up to it in within a minute or two.

boulders.name: Rupis
boulders.approach: Deep in the south fork of Pine Creek. Maybe 2 miles. 100 yards west of "Enter The Arena"/ Bullnose Wall.

boulders.name: Abutment
boulders.approach: Stick Gully area. Anyone know exact location?

boulders.name: Andy’s Mantle Boulder
boulders.approach: To the right of Solidworks

boulders.name: Bowman's Pretty Face
boulders.approach: From the nice, flat staging area at the base of The Lay Up , go around the right (north) side of the boulder and walk for a minute or two through a rocky field, passing one other large boulder on the way to the face.

boulders.name: Dot Matrix Boulder
boulders.approach: 30 second walk directly SE from the Stick Heater Boulder.

boulders.name: Jabberwocky
boulders.approach: See parent area for approach instructions. The boulder is one of the first and biggest boulders you come across.

boulders.name: The Lay Up
boulders.approach: See parent area for approach instructions to the Gully. Continue past Jabberwocky to the obvious huge boulder further northwest up the gully.

boulders.name: Manteca Boulder
boulders.approach: Stick Gully boulders.

boulders.name: Pink Pony Club Boulder
boulders.approach: This boulder sits above the Dot Matrix and Stick Heater boulder, and below the Snare Kicks and Roni Size boulder. This problem sits on the furthest east side of the boulder.

boulders.name: Purple Pasta Boulder
boulders.approach: If you’re in front of Bowman’s Pretty Face this boulder is about 50 meters NW. A short down climb and scramble left across a slab will lead to more scrambling and hopping to the base of the boulder.

boulders.name: Roni Size Boulder
boulders.approach: Walk past the Giant, "Jabberwocky" boulder by about 100 feet, and look towards your right.

boulders.name: Snare Kicks Boulder
boulders.approach: From the base of the Jabberwocky boulder, hike two minutes northwest, Roni Size will be on your left and Snare kicks will be on your right.

boulders.name: Solidworks
boulders.approach: This boulder is shortly before Jabberwocky off the right side of the trail in a small area shared with Andy’s Mantle Boulder and Stick Heater Boulder .

boulders.name: Southern Drawl Boulder
boulders.approach: Continue up Stick Gulley about 15 minutes above the Bowman’s Pretty Face boulder. You can get there multiple ways, and some are easier than others. Directly behind the BPF boulder is a scramble that leads to easier…

boulders.name: Stick Heater Boulder
boulders.approach: Just down the hill from Jabberwockey

boulders.name: Tragically Hip Boulder
boulders.approach: Directly above the Southern Drawl Boulder.

boulders.name: Wishbone Boulder
boulders.approach: Take the main Pine Creek Canyon trail to a fork that forms a loop. Take the right (north) option of the fork, as you would for Stick Gully and Beyond . Continue on this trail, passing the turnoff for the climber's trail…

boulders.name: 25 Cents Boulder
boulders.approach: Start off on the Pine Creek Canyon trail, turn left on the Knoll trail, then aim for Juniper Canyon.

boulders.name: Community Service
boulders.approach: Approach as for Juniper Canyon, make your way to the hill in the back of the canyon, staying high on the right. Eventually you will pass Stand and Deliver on the left with Community Service about 2 more minutes down the…

boulders.name: The Cubicle
boulders.approach: Hike the most established trail that branches off of the Knoll Trail at the first trail marker after the trailside boulder you pass on the way up. Continue through the boulder field on the hillside, passing the candy…

boulders.name: Shoulder Boulder
boulders.approach: After passing the Streak Sauce boulder, but before reaching the 25 Cent boulder, turn right off of the trail and walk uphill for less than 5 minutes. The large boulder is visible from the trail.

boulders.name: Sowbelly
boulders.approach: This is the first huge boulder just right of the Knoll Trail when approaching the canyon. ~35 mins.

boulders.name: Streak Sauce
boulders.approach: On the uphill side of the Knoll Trail, literally on top of it.

boulders.name: The Bees Knees
boulders.approach: 1 minute prior to reaching the Silly Patch, this lonely boulder rests 75 yards up the west facing hillside of the Beehive Knoll/Wilson Pimple.

boulders.name: Hey Bud Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach as for Whale Bacon

boulders.name: No Idea Boulder
boulders.approach: Approach as for Tilt Shift. Once standing in front of Tilt Shift, this boulder can be easily accessed by walking just to the right of the problem.

boulders.name: Silly Patch Boulders
boulders.approach: Follow directions to the Beehive Knoll area using Tom Moulin's fantastic bouldering guide. The Silly Patch sits at the southwest edge of the Beehive Knoll/Wilson Pimple, left of the main trail and about 2 minutes prior…

boulders.name: Tilt Shift Boulder
boulders.approach: Approximately 45-55ish minute hike. Head to the Oak Creek parking lot off of the scenic loop and proceed to the southwest trail and hike towards Oak Creek Canyon. Once past Beehive Knoll on the left, take the trail…

boulders.name: Whale Bacon
boulders.approach: See the Beehive Knoll Area approach instructions. As of Jan 2022, there did not appear to be a well defined trail directly to this boulder, so keep an eye on the GPS and cut south across the creek when you are level…

boulders.name: American Boulder
boulders.approach: Follow trail from parking. After a slight crest, the trail swings through a small cirque with red dirt underfoot. The American Boulder can be seen on the right, 160 yards up a gentle grade from the trail.
